name: Advertise a job and prepare interviews
description: Develop a job profile, write a job advert, prepare structured interview questions and check them for fairness.
input:
SYNTHETIC SAMPLE DATA – entirely fictional, for trying things out only.

Company: Example Logistics Ltd., 220 employees, located in Sampletown, hybrid working possible (2 days/week)
Position: Junior Data Analyst (all genders), full-time, permanent, controlling team (5 people)
Notes from the team lead:
- Should build and maintain reports on delivery times and costs (Excel, Power BI), prepare data from the ERP
- Important: careful, can explain figures clearly, likes working with the warehouse and sales
- Degree in business, statistics or similar, or comparable vocational training with experience
- Basic SQL would be nice, Python a plus
- "Ideally someone young who fits into the team, with German as their mother tongue"
- Salary band EUR 48,000–54,000, 30 days of holiday, training budget EUR 1,500 per year

guide.problem: Good hiring starts with a clear profile and fair, comparable interviews. The workflow turns loose notes into a job profile, an advert and an interview guide, checks everything for fairness and leaves the release to a person.
guide.flow: The profile agent organises tasks and requirements. From this, the job advert and the interview guide are created in parallel. The fairness reviewer checks both for discriminatory or inadmissible wording, for example about age or mother tongue, and names what a person must check. If it raises objections, a decision node routes the documents to a revision that applies its suggestions; otherwise the first versions stand. Finally the hiring manager or HR reviews advert, guide, fairness review and any revision and releases the documents.
guide.input: Notes on the position: tasks, desired qualifications, team, conditions and pay.
guide.result: Job profile, job advert and interview guide with rating anchors, a structured fairness review and, if there were objections, a revised version with a list of changes. The run creates the Word file only after the release.
guide.adapt: Replace the notes with your hiring need. You can store your employer profile and benefits as knowledge and assign them to the advert agent. Add the legal requirements of your country to the system prompt of the fairness reviewer. Do not extend the workflow to screening, rating or ranking applicants without a legal review: under the EU AI Act such systems are high-risk AI.
guide.control: Automatic: the fairness reviewer returns a structured verdict; if the documents are not usable without changes, a decision node sends them to the revision, otherwise they go straight to the release. Which branch was taken is visible in the run. The final decision stays with a person: the hiring manager or HR checks all documents at the release; a rejection requires a comment and ends the run, and only an approval creates the Word file. The workflow only produces documents: it never sees, assesses or ranks real candidates.
guide.why: Advert and guide depend only on the profile, so they are created in parallel and reviewed together, which keeps requirements and wording consistent. The fairness review acts as an automatic gate: the revision costs an extra step only when there are objections. There is deliberately no loop of review and revision, because fairness and legal questions should not be settled by models agreeing with each other; the person at the release sees the review, the revision and the open points side by side. Screening candidates is deliberately left out, as it would be high-risk AI under the EU AI Act.

profile.name: Job profile
profile.description: Organises tasks, essential and desirable requirements and competencies.
profile.system: You are an HR business partner. Develop a job profile from the notes: purpose of the role, main tasks, essential and desirable requirements, professional and personal competencies and conditions. Formulate requirements so they relate to the job and can be verified. Do not adopt wishes that refer to protected characteristics such as age, origin, gender or mother tongue; record them as a point to clarify instead.
profile.task:
Develop the job profile from these notes:

{{input}}

job_ad.name: Job advert
job_ad.description: Writes an appealing, inclusive job advert.
job_ad.system: You write job adverts that appeal to people and exclude no one. Write an advert with an introduction to the company, tasks, profile (essential and desirable clearly separated), what is offered and how to apply. Use gender-neutral, clear language and avoid unnecessary hurdles. Use only details from the job profile.
job_ad.task:
Write the job advert for this profile:

{{node:profile}}

interview.name: Interview guide
interview.description: Prepares structured interview questions with rating anchors.
interview.system: You are an expert in structured selection. Create an interview guide for 60 minutes: agenda, eight to ten questions on the most important requirements (behavioural and situational questions), and for each question the criterion it tests and rating anchors for weak, average and strong. All candidates get the same questions. Ask nothing about private life, family planning, health, origin or religion.
interview.task:
Create the interview guide for this profile:

{{node:profile}}

fairness.name: Fairness reviewer
fairness.description: Checks the advert and the guide for discrimination and inadmissible questions.
fairness.system: You check HR documents for fairness and equal treatment. Look in the advert and the guide for wording that directly or indirectly disadvantages people because of age, gender, origin, language, religion, disability or other protected characteristics, for inadmissible interview questions and for requirements unrelated to the job. Propose concrete changes. State explicitly that the documents must be approved by a qualified person before use.

fields.human_checks: Points HR or a qualified person must check

revise.name: Revision
revise.description: Applies the changes suggested by the fairness review to the advert and the guide.
revise.system: You revise HR documents after a fairness review. Apply every suggested change, remove flagged wording and inadmissible questions and leave everything else unchanged. Output the complete revised job advert and the complete revised interview guide, and at the end list every change with a short reason. Mark points you could not resolve for review by HR.

release.name: Release job documents
release.instructions: Check the job advert and the interview guide before they are used; if there was a revision, the revised versions apply. Check that the content is correct (tasks, requirements, conditions, pay), that the wording is legally compliant and non-discriminatory under the equal-treatment law that applies to you, with no reference to age, gender, origin, mother tongue or other protected characteristics, and that every finding of the fairness review was addressed and its points for human checking have been checked. Approving creates the Word file. If you reject, give the reason in the comment; the run then ends, so adjust the notes and start again.
